scope: Exploratory n/s comparison on expanded training data and identical existing validation images
primary_question: At the same declared confidence threshold, does s increase malignant detection TP/recall AND reduce benign-image false alerts compared with n?
strict_joint_improvement_definition: s malignant TP > n malignant TP and s benign false-alert image count < n benign false-alert image count; equal or mixed outcomes reported separately
other_reports: all 14 fixed thresholds without grid refinement
same predeclared 10% benign-image false-alert selection rule with threshold differences explicit
training time, parameter counts and peak CUDA allocated memory; no mobile speed claim
limitations: Validation has already been reused for development; this is not a blind test.
Missing training identity links may inflate scores.
One training seed and 41 malignant validation images do not establish population superiority.
n/s initialization transfer and architecture differ; equal training settings do not isolate a single architectural cause.
